result.summary: The main issue is a significant layout error in the restaurant preview at the bottom of the screen, where the content is clipped or improperly rendered.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card featuring a pizza is cut off and missing all textual information (name, rating, delivery time, etc.).
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container layout to ensure the card's content is fully rendered and visible within the scrollable area.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section has an image with a dark gradient overlay that makes the text description potentially difficult to read if there were text labels (currently only visual elements visible).
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper text contrast and padding for labels on promotional images.
